source_text.ISS-0932: id: ISS-0932 (queue Q-915, GH-2066); title: D3: Regulatory Compliance Review definition lacks the 21-day timer path to BaFin escalation; severity MAJOR; discovered_by UAT-RUNNER (ISS-0912 QA re-run 2026-10-01). Symptom: POST /instances/:id/advance-timer on risk-evaluation returns 404; regulatory-auto-escalation only reachable from the post-remediation-check unresolved branch. Evidence test/uat-reports/uat-2026-10-01-ISS0912-NARRATIVE.yaml (D3). Scenario test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/meridian/regulatory-compliance-review-bafin.yaml. Definition fixture test/fixtures/qa/meridian_regulatory_compliance_review_process_definition.json. ORCH findings (verify): risk-evaluation is HUMAN_TASK with only {role}; no pending timer exists so advance-timer 404s (Scheduler.resolve_advance_target picks the single pending timer, 400 if >1, 404 if none); edge timeout-risk-evaluation goes risk-evaluation->risk-evaluation-timeout->severity-routing->findings-sign-off, never regulatory-auto-escalation; HUMAN_TASK escalation_timer_duration only reassigns role; a :TIMER node (duration_iso8601) is the engine's routable timer. Required outcome: after evidence-collection completes a pending P21D timer exists, advance-timer fires it, flow runs regulatory-auto-escalation (SERVICE_TASK POST .../compliance/regulatory-notice) -> end-closed, instance COMPLETED; normal path (risk manager completes risk-evaluation -> severity-routing ...) must keep working with no dangling timer trouble. Consider whether reason 'sla_breach_30_days' must be in the service-task body. No QA data/DB changes; repo fixtures/definitions/tests/docs only; bump fixture version if appropriate.

task.description: WF-03 Step 4d: independently re-verify before issue close. Re-derive from source (not from reports): (1) fixture has risk-evaluation escalation_timer_duration P21D + escalation_role, timeout-risk-evaluation retargeted to regulatory-auto-escalation as the only non-conditioned edge, e3 condition 'true', risk-evaluation-timeout/e4 gone, version 1.2; (2) re-run the two new test files plus qa_fixture_service_task_endpoints_test, persona_actor_seed_drift_test, seed_swiftroute_definition_test yourself and quote counts; (3) confirm outcome vs the issue text: after evidence-collection a pending timer exists, advance-timer path (Scheduler.resolve_advance_target) fires it, regulatory-auto-escalation then COMPLETED; normal path intact; (4) confirm lib/ unchanged (git diff origin/main --stat lib/ excluding design doc) and no QA data touched; (5) state honestly what remains out of scope (EO-002 body reason, stale escalation timer) so ORCH files follow-ups. Modify nothing but your handoff. You can spawn no one else and must not self-review.

result.summary: PASS. (1) Fixture re-derived from source: version 1.2; risk-evaluation has escalation_timer_duration P21D + escalation_role role-ceo; timeout-risk-evaluation targets regulatory-auto-escalation with no condition (only non-conditioned out-edge of risk-evaluation); e3 condition 'true'; risk-evaluation-timeout node and e4 gone; e5 regulatory-auto-escalation->end-closed intact. seed_meridian_definition.sh header bumped to v1.2; simulation process_policy_binding.yaml mirrored. (2) Independent re-runs: 5 files (2 new + qa_fixture_service_task_endpoints + seed_swiftroute_definition + seed_swiftroute_persona_actors in test/letflow/scripts) 'Result: 60 passed'; test/scripts/persona_actor_seed_drift_test.exs (the real path; handoff's test/letflow/scripts path does not exist) 'Result: 16 passed'; mix letflow.check.test exit 0 'OK -- isolated :lua_wallclock_race run also passed clean' (it ran the full parallel partitioned suite). (3) Outcome: engine test E1 asserts after evidence-collection a pending escalation timer on risk-evaluation (fire_at-created_at ~21d), Scheduler.resolve_advance_target(instance,nil,schema) returns it (pre-fix 404), fire_timer -> task cancelled -> regulatory-auto-escalation dispatch to .../compliance/regulatory-notice -> poller re-entry -> instance COMPLETED, events INSTANCE_STARTED,TASK_COMPLETED,TIMER_FIRED,SERVICE_TASK_COMPLETED, no pending timers; E2 normal path completes risk-evaluation -> severity-routing -> findings-sign-off with no BaFin dispatch. (4) git diff origin/main --stat -- lib/ is empty (lib unchanged; design doc is untracked under lib/letflow/design/); changes are fixtures/script comment/tests/docs only; no QA data or DB touched.
